items.name: Default
items.summary: Basic relative time formatting with auto unit selection. Use for displaying human-readable relative timestamps in content areas, feeds, or metadata.

items.name: Numeric
items.summary: Numeric formatting control for natural language output. Use 'auto' to display natural forms such as 'yesterday' instead of '1 day ago'.

items.name: FormatStyle
items.summary: Format style presets for controlling output verbosity. Use 'short' or 'narrow' for compact layouts such as data tables or timelines.

items.name: Unit
items.summary: Explicit time unit selection for keeping relative time in a fixed unit. Use when you always want output in days, months, or years instead of letting the component auto-select the unit.

items.name: Locale
items.summary: Explicit locale settings for internationalized relative time output. Use when the target audience locale differs from the document language or browser default.

items.name: DateAttribute
items.summary: Date attribute input for values supplied by JavaScript or bound data. By default, the component formats text content, which also serves as the SSR fallback, and `date` wins when both are present.

items.name: Sync
items.summary: Auto-updating relative time with the sync attribute. Use for live feeds, notifications, or dashboards where freshness matters.
